d:
Actor Sharad Kapoor, known for his role in Shah Rukh Khan's film Josh, has been in the news after videos showed him parting with his four pet dogs. The dogs have been moved to an animal welfare centre, while questions have been raised about his living conditions and their care. Sharad has now appealed to the film industry for work and support. Here's what happened.
